text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...—Today, for sure.
To Master... write a letter...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(Mission progress is smooth. Stimulated by external
factors, both students and environment are revitalizing.
Within me, too... a not-unwelcome change has emerged.)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—I want to share this with Master.
...—But.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...So difficult.
Words are—abstruse.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ah, this might be good! The photo of the Summer Walk
with Heart-san and Messiah-san!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Agreed!♪ That BBQ was the spark that helped
us all grow even closer—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —You two, what are you doing?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe♪
We're making a scrapbook!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
We're gathering all sorts of photos from since we entered the academy,
hoping to preserve the path we've walked in a tangible form.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...—
May I... see?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: (This is... the path they have walked...)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: (How... eloquent.)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —...Great.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—More than words, deep and clear, it conveys.
—...It can convey.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I too—want to make a scrapbook.
To report to Master—as my trajectory.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Wah... How wonderful♪
Your Master will surely be delighted!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Entering the cafeteria, I spotted
Symboli Kris S staring intensely
at a notebook on the table.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Training, races. With this, the photos
concerning mission execution are—all present. But—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—...No.
This is—my... scrapbook.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—To convey to Master... the trajectory
of my mission execution...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward—listening to her halting explanation,
I came to understand her situation.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Different from Craft and Cesario.
Cannot make it the same way—...Why.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—...I want to convey it to Master. The path walked,
its splendor—and yet...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Choosing photos of races and training to show growth—
her 'missions'—wasn't wrong. But.
choice_data_list: It might be good to include photos outside the mission too.
It might be good to include photos outside the mission too.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Outside... the mission...?
choice_data_list: Yeah, like daily life or school events.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—None. Outside the mission—...
I felt no need... to record—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: However—...there is no lie in your eyes.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
In that case—it is necessary.
I shall... gather them...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—...Scrapbook. A difficult—
mission... But I will accomplish it.
